name: [aprile] game with evil
desc:
NEW ABILITIES AND GAMEMODES!
Cool Patch: New variants, ability reworked mechanic and more!

game with evil is an asymmetrical survival game mainly inspired by die of death, please do not play this game competitively as this game features a lot of random stuff such as gamemodes to spice up the rounds and make it more fun.

The game is on a very early development stage, don't mind any random bugs or balance issues n such all will be addressed in due time

Thank you for supporting this game, I will try on making it better with each update!
